title: Duplicate check, spam and abuse limits for submissions
description:
As the publication desk, I want duplicates caught and abuse limited, so that public-immediate submissions do not flood the board.

```gherkin
Feature: Submission limits
  Scenario: Exact duplicate
    Given a submission with the same canonical URL already exists
    When a reader submits it again
    Then the reader is shown the existing item instead of creating a second

  Scenario: Same domain warning
    Given the same domain was submitted recently
    When a reader submits another URL on it
    Then a warning shows the recent item, and the reader may continue

  Scenario: Rate limit
    Given a reader exceeds the configured submissions per period
    Then further submissions are rejected until the period passes

  Scenario: New account limit
    Given an account younger than the configured minimum age
    Then it is held to a lower submission limit
```

Rate limits and account-age thresholds are per-publication configuration. Edge protection (WAF) follows the existing plugin contract.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Built: exact canonical-URL 409, same-domain 48h similar warning, 10/day (a third for new accounts), Humanus rule signals in the worker.
